host.name: James and Karen Smith
host.badge: Premier Host (VRBO: 'They consistently provide great experiences for their guests')
host.about: I'm a grandfather of 15 and bought our place for family times. Our family/friends have vacationed in Kissimmee as renters for years and renting a dream home has come to be a better way to spend quality time all together. We love seeing Disney again through our kids and grandchildren's eyes and hope that everybody has that opportunity. We believe that people do business with people so call us so we can help it happen. We've done it all.
host.why_this_property: Our favorite times are sitting around in the morning Floridian sunshine, having our cup of coffee the kids in the pool and watching the outside TV, we're always there. At night the kids and adults after a dip in the pool or a long day at the parks meet in the game room, singing, dancing, and playing the games (I always lose). There's been many a night upstairs when the adults and kids play poker. The clubhouse is the best we've seen and so close...Head over there DAY 1 and get excited. To us our place down in Kissimmee is our favorite place to be.

description_full:
See NEW last minute discounts + FREE POOL HEAT for limited time, only. Orlando-Kissimmee's Windsor at Westside's "Second Star to the Right". Luxury 7 bedroom pool-spa vacation home. WOW Karaoke TV  DJ lights game room. Patio TV, Just steps to amazing clubhouse! In Kissimmee! We offer generous cancellation terms.
 
Windsor at Westside is an upscale gated resort completed 6 years ago. A really very short walk from our home is all it takes to the amazing world class 10,000 sq foot clubhouse featuring a bar, food, drinks, fireplace, sundries shop, Lazy River, huge zero entrance resort heated pool, Aquapark, lake, cabanas, large hot spa, multiple sports courts including pickleball, extended hours gym, covered playground, arcade room, frozen yogurt area, and activities for more fun in the sun.

Then there's the world renown theme parks. 8-10 miles is all it takes to Disney’s World Drive and nearby  there's Universal Studio/ Sea World. Universal’s new parks opens this year! Excellent dining, golf, water parks, shopping, and outlets are all close by.

 Vacation Home: Your villa-home is designated as a Grand Collection villa. The professionally decorated exceptionally beautiful villa features 7 BR with 4 Kings (1 downstairs) sleeps 14-17*, a 1st floor parlor plus a huge 2nd floor parlor with a poker table and playstation4, 11 wall mounted smart TVs. There's an outside TV and free 100 Mbps- Wi-Fi /DVDs/ phone. At night poker and card games with the kids were great. Both Keurig type and regular drip coffee makers and fully furnished open design kitchen with everything you’d need. Downstairs master with its own bath (shower and separate tub) and separate access to pool is so convenient and there's another 1/2 bath downstairs, 5 1/2 baths in all. Pool and patio access to the bathroom is also very convenient. The full size GREAT gameroom man-cave, features a stage/karaoke machine, real DJ lights, cordless mikes and various karaoke CDs, for singing etc. The smart TV is also connected to the karaoke so that everybody can sing along, if you dare! Watch TV/YouTube music videos with lyrics. Connect ability for your music devices. There's a bluetooth PA system, a Megatouch touchscreen bar table game with over 100 games, bar table, pool table, and air hockey. The touchscreen game offers 1-4 players and has card games, trivia/puzzles,  action games, strategy, and kids games for hours of fun and competition. Our favorite game is Take 2....try it. Large connections 4 game. 

Private Pool-spa, you’ll love the hot tub while watching the outside TV.
Outside, there's a lanai-patio, large table for dinning, DRYER, and private heated lit pool and spa, we're always there. Outdoor dryer for wet bathing suits and warm towels is a surprising luxury….Step outside, morning coffee, relaxing, planning the day, the kids in the pool and watching TV in the Florida sun...Ah heaven. We have pool children fence. 

 The washer and 2 dryers are on the first floor and there's multiple children's accessories (high chair, 2 pack & play cribs, stair fence, and a stroller), linens, and  there's even blow driers.   You're just a few miles from Disney's magic and Universal/Seaworld and the  famous route 192 all its attractions/restaurants and a bit further is International Drive with its entertainment, night life, dining,  Eye and Convention Center. Tampa's Hardrock Casino is an hour away, if you're feeling lucky.

Our family/friends have vacationed in Kissimmee as renters for years and renting a dream home has come to be a better way to spend quality time together. We hope that you consider renting from us during your next trip and we sincerely wish you and your family the very best experience possible.

No smoking inside game room or villa. Smoking permitted in the pool area. No pets. No diving, glass, or unsupervised children in the pool area. Use the children safety pool fence. It’s the law if there’s children. FREE POOL SPA-HEAT Spa/Jacuzzi heat requires the pool to be heated.)  No resort fees. Compare. There is only an additional tax, cleaning fee, plus tax, and VRBO charge (see price details). (*17 guests usually requires sleeping 4 children in the bunk bed-trundle room ( 1 on top, 2 bottom, 1 in pullout trundle) and 2 guests in the double bed.)

Please review POLICY and PAYMENT at the bottom of the" Rate" page. There’s a 10% discount for returning guests, military members, and stays for 7 nights or more (only one discount per reservation).

Construction in the resort totally complete for some years. Only starter amounts of toilet paper cleaning goods and garbage bags are provided and no starter food is provided (per law). There now is a maximum of 4 cars. If you have any questions or concerns please don't hesitate to ask. People do business with people give us a call and begin your vacation dreams.
Free Pool/spa heat currently running  a special.  All prior reservations will remain unchanged.  

WHY US?:
REALLY VERY CLOSE to the clubhouse (800 feet) such a plus!
Gated WINDSOR AT WESTSIDE RESORT with a world class clubhouse and all but purchases are complimentary!
 WOW Game room Karaoke + stage with speakers-mikes-real DJ lighting- Megatouch gaming-TV-pool table- air hockey- bar table! Large Connect 4 game
Beautifully decorated 7 bedroom villa with everything  and over 100 five out of 5 star reviews.
Outdoor TV! and free spa/pool heat, outdoor closet with one of the two dryers, overhead fan, and kid pool fence. 
Convenient to theme parks, golf, restaurants, and attractions.
Our great, friendly , professional management company over 30 years strong, 24/7hours on call. 
Smoke and pets free (outdoor smoking permitted). 
Smoke and CO detectors, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, urgent care center just 2.5 miles away.
Our updated vacation emails with all sorts of hints and shortcuts. Discounts and specials.
Enhanced cleaning/sanitation as well as relaxed refund policy.

We have been asked to name our villa and loved 'the second star to the right' after Peter Pan's Neverland, a place where you never grow up. Enjoy.
Thank you
